preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 3 and 500.
The number of roads M must be between 3 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Z_i <= 100000 for Z_i in importance_values)
preconditions.description: The importance value of each road must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the product of separation values for all unordered pairs of cities modulo 10^9 + 7.
